Richard Moody’s 30th Annual Holiday Party

Mon, Dec 13, 2021 · 7:00 PM – 10:00 PM · Walrus Gallery

When
Mon, Dec 13, 2021 · 7:00 PM – 10:00 PM
Where
Walrus Gallery
4400 Lyndale Avenue North, Minneapolis, MN
Cost
Free
More: Holiday Charity Party
Join Richard and all his fashionable friends as we celebrate the 30th year of his charity holiday party. New location… Walrus Gallery. This year’s party benefits WE WIN Institute and The Sanneh Foundation. Please tell your family, friends and share online. This is a free event and supported by our amazing sponsors & the IamMoody Team.
We Win Institute is a Twin Cities nonprofit community-based organization dedicated to creating academic and social success for all children. http://we-win.org/
The Sanneh Foundation empowers kids, improves young lives, and unites communities through the advancement of diversity, equity, and community well-being. http://www.thesannehfoundation.org/
We kindly ask you to bring an unwrapped gift for teens because they are typically forgotten. Donations are also accepted. All gifts received will be donated to the WE WIN Institute and The Sanneh Foundation
Valet Parking will be available for $10.
